title: AI-generated renderings of Incident 3: distant light on highway and orange orb at roadside
description: Two AI-generated night scenes labeled "Incident 3", both seen from a vehicle's driver position on a two-lane paved highway with yellow center lines. The top image shows a single bright light far down the road between dark hills. The bottom image shows a large glowing orange, elliptical object against a hillside beside a curve in the road. The page closes with the signature block of the Director, AARO; marked UNCLASSIFIED, page 8.
